finalEngineeringSummary:
## QR codes for short links

**What changed.** A new `qr` feature package in `shortener-service`:
- `QrCodeController`: public `GET /{code}/qr?size=`, redirect rate limit, `Cache-Control: max-age=0, private`.
- `QrCodeService`: serves only `ACTIVE` links, read from the database (not the redirect cache, see ADR-0005); size 128-1024, default 256.
- `QrCodeEncoder`: ZXing core, error correction M, quiet zone 1, 1-bit PNG, deterministic.
- New problem type `/problems/invalid-qr-size`; new dependency `com.google.zxing:core` 3.5.3.

**Why.** The QR code encodes the short URL so scans are counted and stop working when the link is deleted; the database check makes deletion take effect immediately despite BF-1.

**How it was verified.** `mvn -q -pl shortener-service -am verify`: build succeeded, 278 tests green, 94.8 % line coverage. `QrCodeIT` decodes the PNGs and covers AC-1 to AC-10, including deletion after a QR code was served.
